title: Find Providers Who Completed All Visit Types
prompt: You are analyzing provider performance across a telehealth platform. Write a query that returns each provider who has successfully completed at least one visit in ALL three visit types: 'initial', 'follow_up', and 'urgent'. A visit is considered successfully completed when `status = 'signed_off'`. Return the provider's ID, name, and the total count of their signed-off visits across all types. Order results by total count descending, then by provider name ascending. If a provider has signed-off visits in only one or two visit types, do not include them. If a provider has zero signed-off visits, do not include them.
schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE providers (provider_id INT PRIMARY KEY, provider_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, specialty VARCHAR(50)); CREATE TABLE visits (visit_id INT PRIMARY KEY, provider_id INT NOT NULL, patient_id INT NOT NULL, visit_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, booked_at TIMESTAMP, completed_at TIMESTAMP);
example_input_data: INSERT INTO providers (provider_id, provider_name, specialty) VALUES (1, 'Dr. Alice Chen', 'Primary Care'), (2, 'Dr. Bob Martinez', 'Psychiatry'), (3, 'Dr. Carol Lee', 'Dermatology'), (4, 'Dr. Dan Kim', 'Primary Care'); INSERT INTO visits (visit_id, provider_id, patient_id, visit_type, status, booked_at, completed_at) VALUES (101, 1, 501, 'initial', 'signed_off', '2024-01-10 09:00:00', '2024-01-10 09:30:00'), (102, 1, 502, 'follow_up', 'signed_off', '2024-01-11 10:00:00', '2024-01-11 10:25:00'), (103, 1, 503, 'urgent', 'signed_off', '2024-01-12 14:00:00', '2024-01-12 14:15:00'), (104, 2, 504, 'initial', 'signed_off', '2024-01-10 11:00:00', '2024-01-10 11:40:00'), (105, 2, 505, 'follow_up', 'signed_off', '2024-01-13 15:00:00', '2024-01-13 15:30:00'), (106, 3, 506, 'initial', 'cancelled', '2024-01-14 08:00:00', NULL), (107, 3, 507, 'initial', 'signed_off', '2024-01-15 09:00:00', '2024-01-15 09:20:00'), (108, 4, 508, 'urgent', 'no_show', '2024-01-16 13:00:00', NULL);

composite_moves: group-aggregate per provider_id to get distinct visit_type set and total count
row-filter: keep only providers with all 3 distinct visit_types

hints: You need to determine which providers have signed-off visits in all three visit types.
Consider grouping visits by provider and visit type, then counting how many distinct visit types each provider has completed.
Use a CTE to aggregate per provider the distinct visit types with signed-off status, then join to the providers table and filter for exactly 3 distinct visit types.
answer_key:
WITH provider_stats AS (
  SELECT
    provider_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT visit_type) AS distinct_types,
    COUNT(*) AS total_signed_off
  FROM visits
  WHERE status = 'signed_off'
  GROUP BY provider_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT visit_type) = 3
)
SELECT
  p.provider_id,
  p.provider_name,
  ps.total_signed_off
FROM provider_stats ps
JOIN providers p ON ps.provider_id = p.provider_id
ORDER BY ps.total_signed_off DESC, p.provider_name ASC;

_meta.scenario: a telehealth visit completion funnel from booking to provider sign-off
